conviction_note: Zero: Rockhopper is a pre-revenue Sea Lion developer, so the interim has no earnings bar to beat. Everything material this half (NSAI NPV uplift, the $180m placing at 70p, the $20m open offer, the Argentina sanctions and injunction) is already out through RNS or the wires. The price in the window is set by Argentina headlines whose direction cannot be known ahead of time, and the name's three prior half-year reactions (+2.00, -1.43, +3.01) are small and mixed. I found nothing the price does not already hold.

session_check: bmo if the release happens: every Rockhopper results RNS has gone out before the open. H1 2025 was at 07:00 on 29-Sep-2025, H1 2024 at 07:00 on 26-Sep-2024 and finals at 07:00 on 03-Jun-2026 (https://www.investegate.co.uk/company/RKH). The DATE is NOT confirmed. Rockhopper never issues a Notice of Results, and there is none on Investegate. The company IR site returns an empty 202 to both tools. TradingView's scanner gives 2026-09-24 12:00 UTC with time code 0 and publication-type 10, the same code as most AIM rows that day (scanner.tradingview.com/uk/scan). TipRanks repeats 24 Sep. Quartr lists 2 Oct (https://quartr.com/companies/rockhopper-exploration-plc_22415), which falls after the 30-Sep AIM deadline, so that is an estimate. The cadence fits: the last Thursday or Monday before 30 Sep in 2023, 2024 and 2025. So the date is plausible and unverified, and eu_resolve.py has to settle it from the 24-Sep Investegate day archive. event_confirmed is false because I could not confirm the date, not because I found it to be false.
positioning_check: FCA aggregated net short, current file: 1.21% (https://www.fca.org.uk/publication/documents/aggregated-current-net-short-positions.csv, read 2026-09-23). The historic sheet of https://www.fca.org.uk/publication/documents/aggregated-net-short-positions.xlsx shows 0.91 (Jun), 1.01-1.21 (Jul), 1.10 (28-Jul to 2-Sep), 1.17 (4-8 Sep), 1.43 (8-Sep to 21-Sep), then 1.21. The baseline's +0.33 'building' is therefore stale: since ~21-Sep sellers have been COVERING about 0.22pp into the print. The ~2% share-count rise from the open offer explains only ~0.03pp of that. No single holder is on the per-holder >=0.5% file for 2025-26. The short is small, not crowded, and shrinking while the price falls. That points to long-side selling (placees below 70p, retail) and not to informed shorts building.

outside_window.finding: Navitas completing the OSX-1 FPSO purchase (~$125m gross, completion 'expected during the coming month' from 24-Aug) and the terms on which Rockhopper takes its 35% are still open. It could appear in the interim, but the NPV uplift (+$788m 2P+2C) and the funding were already priced by the 26-27 Aug RNS.

Milei's 'national sovereignty defence' bill, which extends sanctions to shareholders, directors and suppliers, has gone to committee. Milei lacks a majority, and passage is not dated inside the window.

Italian disposal (Rockhopper Civita to Zodiac): the long-stop passed on 30-Jun-2026 without Italian regulatory approval, and either party may walk away. The value involved (~$8m held for sale) is immaterial against a ~GBP700m market cap.
CDA development plan and FID are targeted for H1 2028, and exploration drilling (Gwendoline deepening) is to be decided for the early-2027 campaign.
